errors.what: Second sed (widening the number exemption) also rewrote pre-existing amount-parsing regexes in 19 *-to-journal ventures; caught by rerunning all 136 suites, reverted to lines carrying the guard only.

doc_friction.issue: Step 0's open list was 11 control-plane entries, each already with an open owner-gated PR; the step has no note saying to skip entries whose fix PR is waiting, so a run re-checks them all.
'redteam.py targets' piped to grep for files changed on main matched neither bowling.mjs nor youth-lineup-rotator/calc.mjs though both have suites; timed suites by hand and passed --target.

deviations.why: Step 0 asks to fix open defects first; all 11 are control-plane with waiting PRs.
deviations.did: Left them; noted the PR numbers.
deviations.result: Run time went to seeding, hunting and the 152-file class fix.

notes: Guard tightened: csv_formula_guard baseline 508 -> 356 (152 exporters guarded with an anchored, comma-aware number exemption). Local checks: 136 touched venture suites green; platform/ci test_check_csv_formula_guard 14 OK; check_posts ok.

real_defects.issue: lineupCsv wrote player names raw, so a name typed or carried in a shared setup link as =HYPERLINK(...) ran as a formula when the coach opened the CSV in Excel or Sheets (CWE-1236). Guarded with the repository's apostrophe prefix; test in calc.test.mjs.

parsePlayers accepted leaves: at or before late: (e.g. late: 3 | leaves: 1, or late: 4 in a 4-period game) with no error, so the child was silently planned absent for the whole game. Now an error naming the child.

152 more venture CSV exporters (the six commonest one-line quoting helpers: q/csvCell) had no formula-injection guard. Swept with the same anchored guard (number exemption /^-?\d[\d,.]*$/ so comma-decimal negatives like -42,10 stay numbers); all 136 touched venture suites green; baseline 508 -> 356.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: mutation campaign triage, two bug fixes with tests, and a 152-file guard sweep with suite runs

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
